```yaml
    Properties:
```

## Why This Is Asked

## Key Concepts
- AWS Systems Manager Patch Manager for automated patching

- Maintenance windows for scheduled patching
- CloudWatch alarms for compliance monitoring
- AWS Config and SSM compliance reports for auditing

## Minimal IaC Snippet (CloudFormation)

```yaml
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Cross-account patch management resources

Resources:
  CrossAccountRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: ssm-patch-manager-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: arn:aws:iam::SHARED_ACCOUNT_ID:root
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore

  SAPPatchBaseline:
    Type: AWS::SSM::PatchBaseline
    Properties:
      Name: sap-weekly-patch-baseline
      OperatingSystem: AMAZON_LINUX_2
      ApprovalRules:
        Rules:
          - PatchFilterGroup:
              PatchFilters:
                - Key: MSRC_SEVERITY
                  Values: [Critical, Important]
                - Key: CLASSIFICATION
                  Values: [SecurityUpdates, BugfixUpdates]
            PatchSet: AWS_DEFAULT
            ApproveAfterDays: 7
      Description: Weekly SAP OS patch baseline for critical and important updates
```

```yaml
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Resources:
  DRExecutorRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'

          - Effect: Allow

              Service:
                - states.amazonaws.com
```

## Why This Is Asked
This question evaluates the ability to design immutable audit and backup pipelines across multi-account and multi-region SAP deployments, ensuring regulatory retention, tamper-evidence, and auditable disaster recovery tests.

## Key Concepts
- S3 Object Lock in Governance mode for SAP HANA backups
- Cross-region replication for DR bucket redundancy
- CloudTrail multi-region trails combined with OpenTelemetry exporting to a central data lake
- Cross-account KMS CMK grants with key rotation implications
- Least-privilege IAM roles and Service Control Policies (SCPs)
- DR validation and audit integrity verification procedures

## Code Example
```yaml
Resources:
  SapBackupsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub 'sap-backups-${AWS::AccountId}'
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      ObjectLockEnabled: true
      ObjectLockDefaultRetention:
        Mode: GOVERNANCE
        Days: 365
      BucketPolicy:
        PolicyText:
          Version: '2012-10-17'
          Statement:
            - Sid: DenyDeleteWithGovernance
```
